title: A CSS-only carousel drawn as a cover flow
blurb: A list with scroll snap, ::scroll-button() and ::scroll-marker, scrolled by no script. The canvas draws each card as a tilted quad with a reflection: cover flow, a wheel or a fan.
question: Can a carousel written in CSS only (scroll snap, generated buttons and markers) be drawn by a canvas as a 3D cover flow while the scroller keeps touch, keyboard and snapping?
result: Yes, with the cards positioned outside the scroller's clip. Drawable slides inside the scroller get clipped pictures, and scroll snap follows the drawn position of a slide, so the snap stops are left undrawn.
